text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — High 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Thresholds breached: 5m error rate 18% (SLO impact). Severity: S2. Pager duty triggered.

sara: acknowledging. I'm creating a war room and paging on-call. war room: https://warroom.redwood.com/r/zk9aB3 (internal only) — join if you're able. @mike @alex

mike: on-call here, I saw the pager. joining war room now. starting a quick triage: checking gateway metrics + recent deploys.

alex: I can take ownership of mitigation. likely regression from yesterday's edge-proxy rollout but will confirm. planning rollback of edge-proxy canary to previous commit if spike correlates with deploy.

nina: quick customer impact note — spike appears to affect generation requests for longer context (>2048 tokens). early telemetry shows increased OOMs in the transformer worker and 5xx bubbling through gateway. I'm drafting a status page blurb below — please sanity-check before we publish.

sara: go ahead and post the status; mark as partial outage for inference in us-west-2. include impacted customers list if we confirm.

nina: draft status update (please copy/paste to StatusPage):

```
We are investigating elevated error rates for text generation requests in the us-west-2 region (partial outage). Some customers using long-context generation may experience failures or increased latency. Our on-call engineers are actively investigating and mitigating. Dashboard: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/zk9aB3

Time detected: 2026-03-15T14:12:00Z
Impact: Partial outage for /v1/generate in us-west-2
Mitigation in progress: Rolling back recent edge-proxy canary and routing traffic to healthy gateways.
Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have new info.
```

mike: status draft looks good. go ahead and post. I'll run the rollback command now and monitor errors stream. if rollback doesn't reduce 5xx within 3 mins, escalate to infra and consider autoscaling workers.

alex: rollback command I'm running:

```
# rollback canary
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/edge-proxy edge-proxy=registry.redwood.ai/edge-proxy:2026-03-14-commit1234
kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/edge-proxy --watch
```

mike: seeing a flood of this in the gateway logs — repeating KV cache OOMs: 

```
2026-03-15T14:13:22Z gateway[edge-5] ERROR OOM when allocating 512MB for kv-cache
2026-03-15T14:13:22Z gateway[edge-5] 5xx response to client id=gw-9f4c status=502
```

nina: checking customer list — ACME Inc (acme-app) and BetaApp (beta-prod) show elevated error rates >30% in last 5m. I'm opening a targeted support notification for them after we confirm root cause.

eva: internal note — paging policy says if on-call doesn't ack within 2 minutes of pager we escalate to the SRE rotation. Mike acked within 45s so we're good on escalation path.

sara: mike — confirm you want me to notify the support leads for ACME and BetaApp and to send them the targeted message template? If yes, paste your approval and I'll send.

mike: yes please. approve targeted notification. use the short template: impacted endpoints + mitigation steps + link to war room + support contact.

nina: I posted the status page update.

incident-bot: StatusPage update published: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/zk9aB3 — incident id zk9aB3. Visibility: public. (automated)

mike: rollback completed, rollout status returned healthy at 14:16:10Z. immediate drop in 5xx to ~2%. continuing to monitor for 10 more minutes. re-routing rules reverted to baseline.

alex: thanks — I'm staying on the war room to watch KV cache metrics and worker pods. if we see another spike I'll trigger extra worker pool scale up: 

```
# scale workers
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/transformer-workers --replicas=12
```

sara: sent targeted customer notifications to ACME and BetaApp with the approved template. copy of message in war room notes.

nina: log note: correlating deploy time 2026-03-15T14:09:40Z with increased memory usage from transformer-worker image v2.1.4. tagging for postmortem. adding to incident board.

mike: monitoring — 5xx stable at 1-3% now, latency back to normal on most routes. keeping Sev2 until we pass 30m of stable metrics.

sara: assigning follow-ups: alex to file postmortem (owner), nina to create customer follow-up emails + timeline, eva to run perf regression tests on v2.1.4. I'll update the incident card with owners and ETA.

alex: ack, filing postmortem and will include root cause, timeline, and mitigation change to rollout gating.

mike: handing off to morning on-call @dom in 25 minutes. dom, I'll paste a short handoff in 10m with current state and next watch window.

sara: thanks team — please annotate any command outputs or logs in the war room thread. I'll close this Slack thread when we mark resolved in StatusPage.

incident-bot: Pager resolved by mike at 2026-03-15T14:22:30Z. Incident remains open for monitoring and postmortem tasks.
